snippet.title: Blasto (TI-99/4A) gameplay footage
snippet.description:
Port of an arcade game by Gremlin. Drive tanks around, like Combat, shoot mines for points. Is that all? Probably more fun in multiplayer.

The song on the title screen is When Johnny Comes Marching Home.
